checks.signal: Cloud Billing actual spend, Firebase plan usage, Hosting/Functions cost center
checks.threshold: Warning at 80% and critical at 100% of firebase_google_cloud monthly budget
checks.action: Create or verify a Cloud Billing budget alert and keep billed actuals in the weekly cost dashboard.
checks.notification: Budget email notification plus optional Slack relay through existing cost alert draft

checks.signal: Firebase Hosting transfer/storage, Functions/Cloud Run invocations, memory, timeout, and quota usage
checks.threshold: Warning when dashboard usage exceeds 80%; critical when provider quota or deployment limit is reached
checks.action: Review Firebase Usage and Cloud Run/Functions quotas weekly; convert repeated warnings to Cloud Monitoring policies.
checks.notification: Ops Slack/Email after manual threshold confirmation; no provider token is stored in artifacts
checks.source: exports/infra_monitoring_dashboard.json; Firebase Usage dashboard; Cloud Monitoring

checks.signal: HTTPS uptime failures, 5xx responses, Cloud Functions/Cloud Run error logs, TLS certificate failures
checks.threshold: Critical on public demo outage, custom domain strict TLS failure, or repeated 5xx/log-based error spikes
checks.action: Create a Cloud Logging logs-based metric and Cloud Monitoring alert policy for 5xx and function error logs.
checks.notification: Slack webhook or email notification, then follow DR and incident postmortem runbooks
checks.source: exports/uptime_monitor_report.json; Cloud Logging; Cloud Monitoring alert policies

checks.signal: Firebase Performance Monitoring latency, network errors, and custom trace degradation
checks.threshold: Warning on sustained p95 latency regression; critical when user-visible flows breach SLA thresholds
checks.action: Define Performance Monitoring alert events for key user journeys after live traffic exists.
checks.notification: Firebase alert trigger to Cloud Functions or operator email, then GitHub Issue for recurring degradation
checks.source: Firebase Performance Monitoring; Firebase alert triggers
checks.evidence: No production traffic baseline yet; keep as ready gate until enough samples exist

checks.signal: Supabase spend, egress, database size, storage, auth MAU, and plan usage
checks.threshold: Warning at 80% and critical at 100% of supabase_db monthly budget or provider quota
checks.action: Check Supabase billing/usage dashboard weekly and record actuals without project IDs or secrets.
checks.notification: Weekly cost dashboard alert draft plus operator escalation for paid-plan changes

checks.signal: Prometheus-compatible database health metrics from Supabase Metrics API
checks.threshold: Warning on missing scrape; critical on connection saturation, disk pressure, WAL backlog, or error burst
checks.action: Add SUPABASE_METRICS_URL and SUPABASE_METRICS_BEARER_TOKEN as CI/environment secrets before live alerting.
checks.notification: Grafana/Datadog/Cloud Monitoring bridge or GitHub Actions summary; token values never enter reports
checks.evidence: metrics endpoint not configured in this environment

checks.signal: Slow query review, connection pressure, CPU, memory, disk, locks, WAL, cache hit rate, and index advisor findings
checks.threshold: Warning at 80% resource pressure or repeated p95 query latency > 1s; critical on blocking locks or failed diagnostics
checks.action: Use Query Performance / Performance Advisor / Index Advisor review before opening DDL or pool-size changes.
checks.notification: GitHub Issue plus WBS follow-up; production DDL requires migration safety gate

checks.signal: Slack webhook, email destination, GitHub Actions failure, and Issue/Project escalation
checks.threshold: Critical alerts must reach a human-owned channel; warning alerts may stay in scheduled report artifacts
checks.action: Store SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL and email settings only as GitHub/CI secrets; never write them to docs, Sheets, or Issues.
checks.notification: Slack, email, GitHub Issue comment, and Calendar/WBS closeout
checks.source: GitHub Actions secrets; weekly cost alert draft; uptime monitor workflow
checks.evidence: notification secrets not configured locally; CI can inject them

checks.signal: Critical alert handoff, DR escalation, postmortem creation, and WBS follow-up
checks.threshold: Any critical production availability/data-loss/billing runaway alert starts incident handling
checks.action: Open/close GitHub Issue with WBS reference and attach follow-up actions to issues_tracker.tsv and qa_tracker.tsv.
checks.notification: Human operator, GitHub Issue #97, Project #1, and Google Workspace WBS sync

operator_checklist.action: Verify Firebase/GCP budget alert recipients and thresholds before enabling paid expansion.
operator_checklist.evidence: Weekly cost dashboard row for firebase_google_cloud plus Cloud Billing budget policy screenshot/export.

operator_checklist.action: Create alert policies for HTTPS 5xx/log-based errors, Functions/Cloud Run errors, and TLS failures.
operator_checklist.evidence: Alert policy name, notification channel, and GitHub Issue link.

operator_checklist.action: Review Hosting/Functions usage and Performance Monitoring alert events after production traffic starts.
operator_checklist.evidence: Firebase usage dashboard and Performance Monitoring alert settings.

operator_checklist.action: Enable Metrics API/Grafana-style scraping and watch connection, CPU, disk, WAL, cache, and slow query signals.
operator_checklist.evidence: Metrics scrape status plus Supabase Query Performance review artifact.

operator_checklist.action: Route critical alerts to a human-owned channel and open a WBS-linked Issue for follow-up.
operator_checklist.evidence: Issue/Project status, Sheets sync, and Calendar cleanup for completed WBS rows.

escalation_rules: Do not store Slack webhooks, Supabase bearer tokens, database URLs, or billing account identifiers in artifacts.
Treat Cloud Billing budget alerts as notifications, not automatic spend caps.
Convert repeated warning alerts into WBS tasks with GitHub Issues and Project status.
Escalate critical availability, quota exhaustion, or data-loss risk through the DR and incident runbooks.
